ADU218 write-to-read latency, measured
======================================
Device: Ontrak ADU218, USB 0a07:00da
Host: Arduino Uno Q, kernel 6.16.7-g0dd6551ae96b
Read-only: PK/RPK0 only. No relay commanded, no WD armed, DB untouched.
Drained 0 stale reply/replies before starting.

Why: the 200 ms timeout in the plan was justified by Ontrak's examples
plus arithmetic on bInterval=10, while errors.txt was captured at
2000 ms and framing.txt never recorded its trial timeout at all. Since
SILENCE is this device's only error signal, the timeout is the
threshold that decides correct-vs-broken and it had never been measured.

--- PK x200 (expects 3-digit reply) ---
  min      13.80 ms
  median   15.99 ms
  p95      16.35 ms
  p99      16.60 ms
  max      16.65 ms
  short reads: 0
  margin of a 200 ms timeout over max:   12.0x
  margin of a 2000 ms timeout over max: 120.1x

--- RPK0 x200 (expects 1-digit reply) ---
  min      14.43 ms
  median   15.99 ms
  p95      16.38 ms
  p99      16.55 ms
  max      16.65 ms
  short reads: 0
  margin of a 200 ms timeout over max:   12.0x
  margin of a 2000 ms timeout over max: 120.1x

--- do the documented silences still register at 200 ms? ---
(errors.txt established every one of these at 2000 ms)
  RI       -> silent (errno 110) after 202 ms
  XYZ      -> silent (errno 110) after 202 ms
  RPK8     -> silent (errno 110) after 202 ms
  RPA4     -> silent (errno 110) after 206 ms
  DB9      -> silent (errno 110) after 202 ms
  MK9999   -> silent (errno 110) after 206 ms

--- control: link still healthy, and no reply was left queued ---
  PK -> b'\x01000\x00\x00\x00\x00'
  queued replies left behind: 0  (0 means the pairing held)
